entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Look at that line...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could it really be that good...?[n]It's hard to tell just from[n]looking at the place.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...It does smell great though.[n]Um, should we get in line?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've never had ramen this[n]delicious before. I even[n]ended up drinking the broth!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be honest... the last time I[n]was in one of these shops was[n]back with my father...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's... a little difficult[n]going to one of these places[n]alone, don't you think?
Totally.
It's worth trying though.
You're not alone now.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah. I've always dreamed about[n]stopping by a place like this on[n]my way home from school...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Being alone is scary, but I suppose[n]I'll never improve if I avoid things[n]because of what other people think.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm going to keep trying... and I[n]hope you will be there to help me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh!? I don't think I have the[n]courage for that just yet...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I suppose not doing things[n]because of what other people may[n]think won't expand my worldview...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay, I'll do it! I'm going to[n]keep trying, and I hope you'll[n]be there to help me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* Thanks. I wonder if[n]being with you will help me[n]break out of my shell.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either way, I'm going to keep[n]trying... and I hope you'll[n]be there to assist me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you for today. I feel[n]like I might actually get[n]addicted to this ramen...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I may even get an extra-large[n]bowl next time. They won't kick[n]me out if I take too long, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh... There's still a line[n]outside. Shall we head home?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Urk... My stomach feels somewhat[n]heavy... Could we take the longer[n]route home today?
